body: After undergoing two rounds of laser tattoo removal treatments last year, Chrisean Rock has upgraded the Blueface tattoo on her face. Los Angeles-based tattoo artist Nihat Uzuntepe shared videos documenting the process and the final result after adding new ink to Chrisean’s face. The updated Blueface portrait now includes the rapper’s more recent facial tattoos, which he got while in jail, unlike the original version.
